verdict.rationale: Apify's evidence shows CLI tooling and local Actor development (apify-docs-3, apify-probe-4), but nothing indicates a fully self-hostable open-source version of the platform as an alternative to the hosted cloud service — Apify's core value proposition remains the managed cloud platform and marketplace. missing for 10: evidence of an open-source self-hosted runtime/platform replacing the cloud service, docs on self-hosting infrastructure, community confirmation of running Apify independently of apify.com.
